import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        return
    m = int(data[0])
    n = int(data[1])
    total = m + n - 2
    k = min(m - 1, n - 1)
    result = math.comb(total, k)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
